integrity: No claim of independent review or mathematical certification. All symbolic identities in the proof are elementary and independently checked by the included checker. Full historical bibliography has older month/year records, but exact original public-release dates were not verified; the supplied 2010-11-18 date is the earliest verified day-specific electronic source included here.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for four strictly disjoint equal-width mirror-symmetric boundary arcs of the unit disk. Cubic discriminant supplies real-axis critical-point census, not a global level-set classification. Historical Walsh monograph and the full 1948 article were unavailable for decisive text comparison; publication-priority risk remains.
title: Cubic phase diagram for mirror-symmetric four-arc harmonic measure
